name: EfficientNet-B0 FF++ per-frame (video-frames runtime)
reason: Inner checkpoint measured locally and rejected (real face scored 96% fake, manipulated copy scored lower). See experiments/FACESWAP_EVALUATION.md. Use face-manipulation-vit-frames-runtime.json instead.
limitations: Requires the same checkpoint as faceswap-ffpp-runtime.json (scripts/fetch_faceswap.py) plus opencv for frame decoding.
The model was trained on face CROPS; whole-frame scoring is an approximation — faces occupying a small share of the frame weaken the signal. Pair with the face-crop path for precision.
Frame-level mean aggregation, not temporal detection — a faceswap present in few frames may dilute below threshold.
Scores are a prioritization signal, not a truth label.
notes: The 'inner' profile is a complete image-runtime profile: 'checkpoint' resolves relative to this file's directory (models/).
'frames' evenly spaced frames are decoded to temp PNGs and scored through the standard profile path; the aggregate is the mean, and 'models[]' reports each frame's score.
